title: Nesting: add Nest ECS entity, .camproj persistence, and undoable nest commands

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Add the `NestDef` document entity, `.camproj` persistence, cut-data preset lookup, undoable nest commands, and per-sheet setup generation in `camcraft-app`.

Depends on #2158, #2159, and #1862.

## Scope

- **Schema and `.camproj` persistence (`crates/app/src/schema.rs`, `crates/app/src/project/`):**
  - Add `NestDef` in `crates/app/src/schema.rs` and register it in `register_schema`.
  - Store sheet dimensions (`width`, `height`, `thickness`), `edge_margin`, `cut_width` (kerf or router tool diameter), `part_gap`, `allow_parts_in_holes`, material/thickness preset key, part entries (referencing `Sketch` or 3D model silhouettes by name, quantity, optional `sheet_face`, rotation mode, `allow_mirror`, default cut side, per-`ChainId` overrides), and the deterministic solved `NestLayout`.
  - Store placed instance transforms (`tx`, `ty`, `angle_deg`, `mirrored`) and sheet metrics (`utilization_pct`, `sheet_count`, per-sheet `placed_counts`, `unplaced`) without duplicating source geometry.
  - Add `EntityKind::Nest` and `NestDto` in `crates/app/src/project/`, and bump `PROJECT_VERSION`.
- **Material preset lookup (`#1521`, `#1881`, `#1886`):**
  - Read material type, thickness, kerf, cut feed, and pierce dwell from the mounted machine or tool cut-data presets (`crates/tools/src/cutting_rows.rs` / `#1886`).
  - Do not keep a duplicate hardcoded material table in the nest module.
  - Allow explicit user overrides for sheet thickness, cut width, and feed when no preset matches.
- **Undoable commands (`crates/app/src/commands/`):**
  - Implement `CreateNest`, `EditNest`, `AddNestPart`, `RemoveNestPart`, `SetNestProfileSide`, `RunNesting`, and `DeleteNest`.
  - Validate every parameter, quantity, cut width, and rotation step at command construction (never inside systems).
  - Have `RunNesting` compute the deterministic layout from `#2158` and `#2159`, store it in `NestDef`, and create or update one `Setup` per sheet with `StockShape::Box` (`width x height x thickness`).
  - Ensure `undo` and `redo` restore both `NestDef` and any created sheet setups cleanly.

## Done means

Tests in `crates/app` create a nest from multiple `Sketch` and model parts with quantities and cut sides, look up material/thickness/kerf presets from cut data, run deterministic multi-sheet nesting into sheet setups with `StockShape::Box`, report per-sheet counts per part, round-trip `.camproj` and `undo`/`redo`, and refuse invalid numbers or oversized unplaced parts by name.

Part of #2156
